learning_outcomes.text: Explain how M&A fits a corporate growth and portfolio strategy
Screen and evaluate acquisition targets against a strategic thesis
Understand valuation, deal structure and the sources of synergy
Run disciplined due diligence to test the investment thesis
Plan integration to realise value and avoid common destruction traps
Recognise why many deals fail and how to improve the odds

integrative_case: A software company plans to acquire a smaller competitor to enter a new segment: define the acquisition thesis and walk-away price, design diligence to test the riskiest assumptions, assess synergies honestly, and build an integration plan that protects key talent and actually realises the value.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
